title: Key events in Kerala: Book launch, onam khadi fair and cultural programmes on August 25
content: Thiruvananthapuram Press Club: Book launch of "Unarvinte Geetham" by Dr C Narayana Pillai. 5:00 pm. Fine Arts College Art Gallery: Inauguration of Nemom Pushparaj's "Dystopia" art exhibition, featuring poetry and art, by K Jayakumar. 4:00 pm. Kanakakkunnu Palace Auditorium: Aksharashloka recital by Vidyadhiraja Aksharashloka Samithi. 4:00 pm. Kizhakke Kotta E K Nayanar Park: Onam Mega Trade Fair. 10:00 am Pattom Marappalam Swadeshi Centre: Exhibition of Onam products. 10:00 am. Kollam Chinnakkada Bus Bay: Prophet's Birthday Rally and Conference,organized by the Kerala Muslim Jama'ath Federation, Kollam Taluk Committe. Featuring Minister P C Vishnunath. 5:00 pm. Kottayam Chalakunnu Campus Crusade Hall: Jesus Redeems Ministries – Fasting Prayer and Word of God Service. Pastor Reji Narayanan at 10:30 am. SNDP Branch No. 4408, Irinjal: Sree Narayana Jayanthi and the annual consecration anniversary of the Panchaloha idol of Sree Narayana Gurudeva. Kochi Pachalam P J Antony Cultural Centre: Pachala Peruma, organized by the Corporation's 22nd Division – 8:00 pm. Kaloor International Stadium: Vanitha Onam Fair Mega Shopping Festival – 1:00 pm. Edappally Changampuzha Park & Cultural Centre: Aazhchavattom (Members' Program) – 5:30 pm, Folk Songs and Visual Performance by Cochin Chela – 6:30 pm. Elamakkara Ettukad Yuvakalatharang: Onam Celebrations – Fusion Musical Evening by Cochin Jacks – 6:00 pm. Kozhikode Gandhi Ashram, Near Civil Station: Khadi Onam Fair 9:30 am. Noor Complex Book Mall, Mavoor Road: Book Fair 9:30 am. Civil Station Gandhi Ashram Khadi Gramodyog Bhavan: Onam Khadi Silk Fair 10:00 am Mananchira Central Library Building: Mriganayani Onam Fair 10:00 am. Mananchira Khadi Emporium: Khadi Onam Fair 10:00 am. Peoples Bazaar, Near Mofussil Stand: Supplyco Onam Mega Trade Fair 10:00 am. Convent Road: Great Bombay Circus Show 1:00 pm, 5:00 pm, 7:30 pm. Pipeline Road: Marigold Harvest – Mayor O Sadashivan 4:00 pm. Chavara Cultural Centre: Haasya Vedi – "The Audience Are The Stars" Program 4:45 pm. Akashamittayi, Beypore BC Road: Onam Celebration Program by Mehfil Square Beach Band 5:00 pm. Beach Freedom Square: DTPC Onam Celebration: Dance Evening – Lakshmi Gopalaswamy, Comedy Night – Hareesh Kanaran, Nirmal Palazhi 6:00 pm, Music Concert by Bhat Road Beach Music Artists Association 6:00 pm. Mananchira Square: Kalaripayattu 5:00 pm,Theyyam 6:00 pm, Kathakali 7:00 pm, Violin Fusion 8:00 pm. Town Hall: Drama Festival 6:00 pm. Kuttichira: Music Concert and Kolkali 6:30 pm. Thali: Hindustani Ghazal, Bharatanatyam –Ashwathy Sreekanth and Team 6:00 pm.
